acquisition.coverage: tests.synthetic.coverage of a new inscribed finite-D polygon, ppm1 x0=y0=0; float32 area fractions, no table/sheet-boundary signal
acquisition.encoding: independent synthetic.linear_to_srgb, clip/rint uint8 grayscale RGB PNG, then backend.tone.linear_mix; no JPEG/noise/texture/shadow/thickness
acquisition.map: known M=[[1,0,16.5],[0,1,16.5],[0,0,1]], k1=0; +.5 binds area-renderer index centres to photo geometric centres. It is not an observed ring shift.
acquisition.optical: float32 filter2D; BORDER_REFLECT_101; isotropic kernel outer(getGaussianKernel(11,1.2)); directional synthetic.rotated_gaussian(3,1,30). Save actual coefficients, sum, mean and covariance.
acquisition.rectification: backend.sheet.rectify_gray float64 Keys intermediate stored float32; backend OpenCV GaussianBlur sigma.7, compare explicit7x7 post kernel; edge replication inside Keys
acquisition.retention: All source coverage/optical/PNG RGB/decoded arrays, actual kernel arrays, original PNG bytes, pre/post smoothing fields, maps, q, raw-array and file hashes, versions, all row errors and work. Numeric NPZ only, allow_pickle=False.

comparators.forward_api: backend.finite_shape.finite_shape_probabilities on analytic finite-D chord/arc ring, not the renderer polygon. probability_tolerance1e-9, max_panels8192, max_evaluations20000000 per batch. No optimizers/Jacobians/covariance/normal trials.
comparators.moment_gaussian: Sigma=q²*(actual normalized discrete optical kernel covariance+I/12)+actual normalized discrete post-kernel covariance. The I/12 is source pixel-box second moment; Keys reproduces quadratics so contributes zero formal second moment, not a positive PSF. Match moments only, not full operator.
comparators.nominal_gaussian: Sigma=q²*Sigma_optical_nominal + .7²*I; nominal iso1.2²I or rotated diag(3²,1²) at30deg; contrast/background fixed supplied generator levels.

controls.cli: Help/missing/existing/dangling-symlink --output-dir refuses before numerical imports. Strict JSON, fresh destination, complete source hashes before/after, every scene/row exception retained.
controls.constant: Unquantized all-background/all-material fields use the same known-map/post sequence; max plateau drift<=2e-4 levels.
controls.exact_keys: Independent Fraction Keys a=-1/2 at phases0,1/5,1/4,2/5,1/2,3/5,3/4,4/5 (includes actual q1.25 phases and q1 phase1/2). Verify moments0=1,1=2=0,3=f(1-f)(1-2f),4=-9f²(1-f)², ramp/quadratic reproduction. Polynomial identity L1=1+f(1-f)<=5/4 for all0<=f<=1 via1/4-f(1-f)=(f-1/2)²; tensor L1<=25/16. Compare production _keys weights at all declared phases within2e-14.
controls.independent_gaussian: Four diagonal rectangular Gaussian controls (q1/1.25, sigma1.2/3), six fixed integer query points each; analytic erf/erfc product reference independent of area implementation. Every API resolved and discrepancy<=reported error+2e-12 and<=1e-8 probability. Failure withholds study API comparisons, retaining every row.

independent_gaussian_definitions.reference: product over x/y of[erfc((10q-(pixel+.5))/(sqrt2*q*sigma))-erfc((30q-(pixel+.5))/(sqrt2*q*sigma))]/2, supplied source-frame rectangle, no clipping
independent_gaussian_definitions.ring: four line tuples joining consecutive rectangle corners, final closes first

controls.post_kernel: Interior .7 GaussianBlur versus explicit getGaussianKernel(7,.7) outer filter, maxabs<=2e-4 levels (float32 engineering allowance); compare whole fields too, retain border differences.
controls.quantization: For each row, maxabs(PNG final-unquantized final)<=25/16 * maxabs(decoded_linear-optical_linear) +64*eps32*25/16*max(1,maxabs(optical_linear),maxabs(decoded_linear)). Sup-norm propagation through signed Keys, positive smoothing and float32 allowance; not a stochastic noise model.
controls.source_coverage: For each polygon, independent Shapely intersection area on first16 raster boundary cells in row-major order; max absolute disagreement<=2e-7 source-pixel area. All cells and values retained.
controls.tessellation: Arc area loss <=R²*theta³/(12*(8193-1)²), theta=2pi-2acos(f); propagated via max optical weight*25/16*absolute contrast. Retain bound and require<=1e-3 levels; not a camera accuracy bound.

design_status: prospective; frozen before any new coverage, kernel, control, forward or resampling evaluation

execution_order.controls: independent exact Fraction, production Keys, four rectangular Gaussian controls q then sigma. Any failed global numerical control prevents all64 main API calls; retain scene generation and32 unknown rows.
execution_order.scenes: plan order major/minor-rotated, isotropic/directional, phases0..3; source scenes generated once; q1 then1.25 per scene; nominal thenmoment per row; prediction reused unquantized thenPNG.
execution_order.work: Record each attempted/completed forward call/query count plus all returned evaluations/panels; never restart, change budget, retry a failed call or choose a best lane.

historical_policy: No old photo rerender, old fit, old finite-difference replacement or causal attribution of historical errors. Original source PNG/estimated H/kernel/intermediate stages are absent from the portable historical fields.

outcome_policy.geometry: No fitted geometry, no recovery/target-pass counts, no physical optics or automatic correction claim. Radius/chord/depth are fixed generator definitions, not measured validations.
outcome_policy.protocol: Protocol success means complete population, stable inputs and all declared numerical/control contracts, not Gaussian adequacy. Incompatible Gaussian rows are valid adverse outcomes.
outcome_policy.representation: The represented-polygon chain is fully archived. Analytic D is the intended geometry; tessellation allowance prevents classifying a one-level boundary case on inscribed-polygon error alone. Float32 allowance is declared before execution, not estimated from model discrepancy.
outcome_policy.status: For each stage/covariance cell use max_abs residual over441points. E=max API intensity error + retained analytic-D tessellation level allowance +64*eps32*25/16*max(1,source optical peak,source decoded peak). Compatible iff max_abs+E<=1; incompatible iff max_abs-E>1; otherwise inconclusive. Quantization is an intentional stage difference, not added as random uncertainty. These engineering allowances are not rigorous enclosures.
outcome_policy.unknown: Unresolved/None API values or comparator exceptions retain all returned query statuses/errors/work and receive numerical_unknown adequacy, never fabricated predictions or incompatible labels. Later comparators/rows/scenes continue. Every scene/q identity retained if upstream exceptions occur.

pre_execution_amendment.reason: Static independent review before any new scientific evaluation: bind actual resampling phases, complete rectangle controls, distinguish stage values, and make unknown/call/enclosure semantics explicit. Original plan retained in commit0dfd47e. No outcomes observed or thresholds relaxed.

queries.geometric_centres: API pixel index i queries i+.5; true source geometry stays in plane units, Hout=diag(q,q,1).
queries.integer_pixels: For each q, centre-index=floor(q*true_centre) componentwise; Cartesian offsets -20,-18,...,20 in x/y, ordered y then x. Exactly441 distinct in-bounds output pixel indices.
queries.reuse: Same441 indices across both encoding stages; stage-specific observed values reused unchanged across both covariance comparators. Predictions computed once per covariance/q and reused for both stages. All points are forward diagnostic, never held-out.
